mentions.name: Defense drone
mentions.description: A defense drone developed in a garage workshop, with a small prototype already flying. It adds OpenHD for video transmission and a Raspberry Pi for on-board edge compute, with FHSS, GNSS-denied navigation, and SITL simulation still to be conquered; a modular, quick-swap smart battery pack with telemetry is also being designed for it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a defense drone.

I built a garage workshop with a Shapeoko 5 Pro, X1C, soldering station, and learned CAD (ok just fusion). I have a lil drone in the air and I'm adding OpenHD for vtx, Rpi for on-edge compute (Jetson would be better but is expensive).
